prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
sign_in, copy changes remain consistently helpful, winning 5 out of 8 tests (+2.3% average after noise correction).
adoption, redesign changes are helpful, winning 3 out of 6 tests (+1.8% average after noise correction), while 1 performed worse and 2 showed no clear effect.
home, wait_info changes are helpful, winning 2 out of 6 tests (+2.0% average after noise correction), while 4 showed no clear effect.
finish, new_screen changes failed to sustain early success, with 3 out of 4 tests performing worse or showing no clear effect (-1.3% average after noise correction).
home, new_flow, finish, redesign, choose_path, copy, and adoption, layout changes consistently showed no clear effect or performed worse across multiple tests.
Predictions were overly optimistic for finish, new_screen, finish, redesign, and choose_path, copy changes, predicting positive gains where actual results were mostly negative or had no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Pet Naming Certificate View: Rebuild the adoption certificate screen into a side-by-side split layout displaying the pet live preview next to the official naming input form. (why: Adoption redesigns performed well (+1.8% average boost), while 3 support tickets mentioned issues during custom pet generation or adoption display.)
1: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Retention & Re-login Guarantee Headline: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in preserves their saved pets and prevents data resets. (why: Sign-in copy changes consistently win (+2.3% average gain), directly addressing 8 support emails regarding pets disappearing or resetting after signing in.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render & Engine Load Status Info: Display explicit status progress indicators and initialization stage text on the waiting screen while desktop rendering sets up. (why: Home wait_info tests won +2.0% on average, helping address the high 201s median / 2336s mean waiting time and 3 support tickets about desktop pet render failures.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] List Layout Path Selection Redesign: Reframe the choose path screen using a structured list layout that clearly differentiates starter instant adoption from custom pet creation. (why: Choose path has a long mean time (514s) and an 81.7% conversion rate, so a clear list view helps users make an immediate decision without hesitation.)
4: [adoption, new_flow] Companion Trait & Voice Setup Flow: Introduce a companion trait configuration screen after selecting a pet where users configure personality style and interaction feedback. (why: Resolves user confusion reported in support emails (3 tickets) regarding how to interact with and control the pet post-onboarding.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Controls & Shortcut Summary Copy: Update the home intro text with explicit interaction guidance detailing mouse dragging, system tray controls, and hide/show shortcuts. (why: Directly targets the 3 support emails expressing post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Account Re-Authentication Pet Protection Hint: Add an explicit explanatory hint under sign-in buttons clarifying that account login keeps pet progress saved across app updates. (why: Leverages the strong win rate of sign-in microcopy/hints while mitigating user anxiety over lost pets (8 support emails).)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Engine Launch Notification Prompt: Provide an opt-in system notification trigger on the waiting screen to alert users when the desktop engine finishes loading. (why: The waiting step suffers from a 2336s mean duration; letting users minimize the app and receive a notification reduces drop-off (11.7% abandon on home).)
8: [finish, redesign] Spotlight Layout Home Welcome Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into a spotlight view focusing on key desktop interaction controls alongside the mascot preview. (why: The finish step drops 23% of users; replacing standard text with a spotlight layout increases clarity and onboarding completion rate.)

scores.note: Adoption redesigns show solid performance (+1.8% average), backed by 3 support tickets, but requires full screen redesign.
Sign-in copy changes consistently win (+2.3%), strongly supported by 8 support tickets and very low implementation cost.
Home wait_info interventions show strong track record (+2.0%) and directly address the extreme 2336s mean waiting time.
Choose path redesigns average +1.7% lift across 3 tests, targeting a high drop-off and 514s mean completion time.
Adoption new_flow tested well (+7.1% single test), but adding screens has mixed historical success overall and zero cost score.
Targets the highest drop-off step (23%) and 3 support tickets with low-cost copy updates, though finish copy history is modest.
Sign-in hints perform well (+1.9%) and directly address 8 support emails regarding data security anxiety.
Home notifications showed virtually no gain (-0.1% across 2 tests) despite long wait times.
Finish redesigns consistently failed (-3.8% avg over 2 tests); lessons warn against optimistic predictions here.
